rules.agentNameUniqueAmongActive: An agent's @name cannot be one already used by another active agent; the cm refuses it and the screen tells the admin the name is taken.
rules.agentDraftSuggestedToolsOnWhenReady: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that a draft is ready, the draft kept in this module becomes ready, keeps the tools the cm suggested, and every suggested tool is turned on for that draft's agent in this module.
rules.agentDraftNoticeIdempotent: An agentDraftReady report from the cm, whether ready or refused, that arrives again changes nothing.
rules.adminChoiceNotOverriddenByAutomatic: A tool choice the company admin made for an agent is never changed by the automatic choice of tools.
rules.agentBehaviorChangedOnlyThroughCm: An agent's behavior is read, changed and undone only through the cm; this module never stores it.
rules.behaviorChangeByAdminOnly: Only the company admin may change or undo an agent's behavior.
rules.undoRestoresPreviousBehavior: Undoing a change from the behavior history brings back the behavior the agent had before that change, and the change is shown as undone.
rules.ownConductOnly: An organization member may change only their own conduct with an agent, never the conduct of another person.
rules.conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: A member may change their own conduct only with an agent that has a personal conduct for them, that is, an agent whose reading from the cm brings that member's personal conduct (today only the agent Nora).
rules.simulationSavesNothing: A simulation only shows results and saves nothing.
rules.memberSimulatesOnlyAsSelf: An organization member may simulate an agent only as themselves.
rules.adminSimulatesByRole: The company admin may simulate an agent for a chosen person or for a role.
rules.onlyToolsOnAreConsidered: A simulation considers only the tools that are on for the agent.
rules.personRestrictionAppliesInRequest: When someone calls an agent, the tools that person may not use are not available to the agent in that request.
rules.noTechnicalIdsOnScreen: Screens show readable names only and never show technical ids.
rules.toolKeyUnique: Each action has one tool in the catalog, matched by its stable code when the catalog is rebuilt.
rules.toolNeverDeleted: A tool is never deleted from the catalog; one that leaves the release is marked removed.
rules.catalogRebuiltOnRelease: The tool catalog is rebuilt when a module is created or a new release arrives: new tools are created, tools that already exist are updated by matching their stable code, tools that left the release are marked removed, and tools that came back become available again. On every rebuild, each tool's stored catalog item is replaced with the whole item as the platform delivers it, so the stored catalog never goes stale.
rules.removedToolNotSent: A tool marked removed is not sent to the cm as a tool an agent may use.
rules.adminChoiceNeverOverridden: Once the admin has turned a tool on or off for an agent, no automatic step changes that choice.
rules.oneChoicePerAgentAndTool: There is at most one on or off choice for each pair of agent and tool.
rules.onlyEnabledToolsSent: When the cm asks for an agent's tools, only the tools that are on for that agent are sent, each with its whole stored catalog item.
rules.removedToolNeverSent: A tool choice that refers to a removed tool is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.
rules.personRestrictionsExcludeTools: When the cm asks for an agent and a person, the tools that person may not use are left out of the tools returned.
rules.repeatedNoticeChangesNothing: A notice from the cm that has already been handled changes nothing when it arrives again.
rules.draftSuggestedToolsTurnedOn: The tools suggested in a ready draft are turned on for it as automatic choices, without changing any choice the admin already made.
rules.restrictionUniquePerPersonTool: A person has at most one restriction for each tool.
rules.restrictionAppliesThroughAnyAgent: A tool restricted for a person cannot be used by that person through any agent.
rules.onlyCompanyAdminRestrictsTools: Only the company admin may mark or unmark the tools a person may not use.
rules.removedToolRestrictionKept: A restriction on a tool that was marked removed is kept and has no effect while the tool is gone.
rules.executionRecordedOnce: The same finished execution is never recorded twice, even when its summary arrives again.
rules.onlyInboundWritesExecution: Execution summaries are recorded only from what the cm sends.
rules.executionNeverEdited: A recorded execution summary is never changed afterwards.
rules.onlyActiveUsersRestricted: Only active organization users are offered for tool restrictions and for simulation.
rules.draftDecisionOnlyWhenReady: Only a ready draft can be decided on: activating it makes it activated and discarding it makes it discarded.
rules.refusalReasonShownWhenRefused: A refused draft is shown with the reason the cm gave for refusing it.
rules.activityNewestFirst: An agent's activity is listed newest first.
rules.newToolsChosenFromDescription: New tools in the catalog are chosen automatically from each agent's description for every agent of the company, read from the cm, not only for agents that already have a tool choice; the admin may then adjust them.
rules.describeAgentForPersonWritesNothing: When the cm asks this module to describe an agent for a person, the module only reads: it returns only the tools that are on for that agent, minus the tools that person may not use, each with its whole stored catalog item; it invents nothing and writes nothing.
rules.toolKeepsWholeCatalogItem: Each tool in the catalog keeps the whole catalog item as the platform delivers it, not a part of it.
rules.agentToolsShowWholeCatalog: The agent tools screen shows every action of the tool catalog, with the ones the agent has turned on shown as marked.
rules.markingWithoutChoiceCreatesAdminChoice: When the admin marks an action the agent has no choice for yet, a new choice for that agent and that action is created as an admin choice; marking or unmarking an action that already has a choice only turns that choice on or off.
rules.agentDraftRecordedBeforeSending: When the admin asks for a new agent, this module records the prompt, who asked and when, starts the draft as preparing, and then sends the request to the cm.
rules.refusedDraftKeepsReason: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that it refused a draft, the draft becomes refused and keeps the reason the cm gave; no one on the screen makes a draft ready or refused.
rules.conductChangeRecorded: Every time a member changes their conduct with an agent, this module records who changed it, when and a one-line summary; the current conduct itself stays in the cm.
rules.ownConductHistoryOnly: A member, and likewise the company admin, sees only their own conduct changes, newest first, never anyone else's.
rules.toolCatalogTextsStoredAsDelivered: The tool texts that come from the platform (the tool's stable code, module, subject, name, module title, subject title and release label) are stored exactly as they arrive: this module sets no size limit of its own, never cuts them and never refuses them for their size.

rules.agentNameUniqueAmongActive: An agent's @name cannot be one already used by another active agent; the cm refuses it and the screen tells the admin the name is taken.
rules.agentDraftSuggestedToolsOnWhenReady: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that a draft is ready, the draft kept in this module becomes ready, keeps the tools the cm suggested, and every suggested tool is turned on for that draft's agent in this module.
rules.agentDraftNoticeIdempotent: An agentDraftReady report from the cm, whether ready or refused, that arrives again changes nothing.
rules.adminChoiceNotOverriddenByAutomatic: A tool choice the company admin made for an agent is never changed by the automatic choice of tools.
rules.agentBehaviorChangedOnlyThroughCm: An agent's behavior is read, changed and undone only through the cm; this module never stores it.
rules.behaviorChangeByAdminOnly: Only the company admin may change or undo an agent's behavior.
rules.undoRestoresPreviousBehavior: Undoing a change from the behavior history brings back the behavior the agent had before that change, and the change is shown as undone.
rules.ownConductOnly: An organization member may change only their own conduct with an agent, never the conduct of another person.
rules.conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: A member may change their own conduct only with an agent that has a personal conduct for them, that is, an agent whose reading from the cm brings that member's personal conduct (today only the agent Nora).
rules.simulationSavesNothing: A simulation only shows results and saves nothing.
rules.memberSimulatesOnlyAsSelf: An organization member may simulate an agent only as themselves.
rules.adminSimulatesByRole: The company admin may simulate an agent for a chosen person or for a role.
rules.onlyToolsOnAreConsidered: A simulation considers only the tools that are on for the agent.
rules.personRestrictionAppliesInRequest: When someone calls an agent, the tools that person may not use are not available to the agent in that request.
rules.noTechnicalIdsOnScreen: Screens show readable names only and never show technical ids.
rules.toolKeyUnique: Each action has one tool in the catalog, matched by its stable code when the catalog is rebuilt.
rules.toolNeverDeleted: A tool is never deleted from the catalog; one that leaves the release is marked removed.
rules.catalogRebuiltOnRelease: The tool catalog is rebuilt when a module is created or a new release arrives: new tools are created, tools that already exist are updated by matching their stable code, tools that left the release are marked removed, and tools that came back become available again. On every rebuild, each tool's stored catalog item is replaced with the whole item as the platform delivers it, so the stored catalog never goes stale.
rules.removedToolNotSent: A tool marked removed is not sent to the cm as a tool an agent may use.
rules.adminChoiceNeverOverridden: Once the admin has turned a tool on or off for an agent, no automatic step changes that choice.
rules.oneChoicePerAgentAndTool: There is at most one on or off choice for each pair of agent and tool.
rules.onlyEnabledToolsSent: When the cm asks for an agent's tools, only the tools that are on for that agent are sent, each with its whole stored catalog item.
rules.removedToolNeverSent: A tool choice that refers to a removed tool is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.
rules.personRestrictionsExcludeTools: When the cm asks for an agent and a person, the tools that person may not use are left out of the tools returned.
rules.repeatedNoticeChangesNothing: A notice from the cm that has already been handled changes nothing when it arrives again.
rules.draftSuggestedToolsTurnedOn: The tools suggested in a ready draft are turned on for it as automatic choices, without changing any choice the admin already made.
rules.restrictionUniquePerPersonTool: A person has at most one restriction for each tool.
rules.restrictionAppliesThroughAnyAgent: A tool restricted for a person cannot be used by that person through any agent.
rules.onlyCompanyAdminRestrictsTools: Only the company admin may mark or unmark the tools a person may not use.
rules.removedToolRestrictionKept: A restriction on a tool that was marked removed is kept and has no effect while the tool is gone.
rules.executionRecordedOnce: The same finished execution is never recorded twice, even when its summary arrives again.
rules.onlyInboundWritesExecution: Execution summaries are recorded only from what the cm sends.
rules.executionNeverEdited: A recorded execution summary is never changed afterwards.
rules.onlyActiveUsersRestricted: Only active organization users are offered for tool restrictions and for simulation.
rules.draftDecisionOnlyWhenReady: Only a ready draft can be decided on: activating it makes it activated and discarding it makes it discarded.
rules.refusalReasonShownWhenRefused: A refused draft is shown with the reason the cm gave for refusing it.
rules.activityNewestFirst: An agent's activity is listed newest first.
rules.newToolsChosenFromDescription: New tools in the catalog are chosen automatically from each agent's description for every agent of the company, read from the cm, not only for agents that already have a tool choice; the admin may then adjust them.
rules.describeAgentForPersonWritesNothing: When the cm asks this module to describe an agent for a person, the module only reads: it returns only the tools that are on for that agent, minus the tools that person may not use, each with its whole stored catalog item; it invents nothing and writes nothing.
rules.toolKeepsWholeCatalogItem: Each tool in the catalog keeps the whole catalog item as the platform delivers it, not a part of it.
rules.agentToolsShowWholeCatalog: The agent tools screen shows every action of the tool catalog, with the ones the agent has turned on shown as marked.
rules.markingWithoutChoiceCreatesAdminChoice: When the admin marks an action the agent has no choice for yet, a new choice for that agent and that action is created as an admin choice; marking or unmarking an action that already has a choice only turns that choice on or off.
rules.agentDraftRecordedBeforeSending: When the admin asks for a new agent, this module records the prompt, who asked and when, starts the draft as preparing, and then sends the request to the cm.
rules.refusedDraftKeepsReason: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that it refused a draft, the draft becomes refused and keeps the reason the cm gave; no one on the screen makes a draft ready or refused.
rules.conductChangeRecorded: Every time a member changes their conduct with an agent, this module records who changed it, when and a one-line summary; the current conduct itself stays in the cm.
rules.ownConductHistoryOnly: A member, and likewise the company admin, sees only their own conduct changes, newest first, never anyone else's.
rules.toolCatalogTextsStoredAsDelivered: The tool texts that come from the platform (the tool's stable code, module, subject, name, module title, subject title and release label) are stored exactly as they arrive: this module sets no size limit of its own, never cuts them and never refuses them for their size.

rules.agentNameUniqueAmongActive: An agent's @name cannot be one already used by another active agent; the cm refuses it and the screen tells the admin the name is taken.
rules.agentDraftSuggestedToolsOnWhenReady: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that a draft is ready, the draft kept in this module becomes ready, keeps the tools the cm suggested, and every suggested tool is turned on for that draft's agent in this module.
rules.agentDraftNoticeIdempotent: An agentDraftReady report from the cm, whether ready or refused, that arrives again changes nothing.
rules.adminChoiceNotOverriddenByAutomatic: A tool choice the company admin made for an agent is never changed by the automatic choice of tools.
rules.agentBehaviorChangedOnlyThroughCm: An agent's behavior is read, changed and undone only through the cm; this module never stores it.
rules.behaviorChangeByAdminOnly: Only the company admin may change or undo an agent's behavior.
rules.undoRestoresPreviousBehavior: Undoing a change from the behavior history brings back the behavior the agent had before that change, and the change is shown as undone.
rules.ownConductOnly: An organization member may change only their own conduct with an agent, never the conduct of another person.
rules.conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: A member may change their own conduct only with an agent that has a personal conduct for them, that is, an agent whose reading from the cm brings that member's personal conduct (today only the agent Nora).
rules.simulationSavesNothing: A simulation only shows results and saves nothing.
rules.memberSimulatesOnlyAsSelf: An organization member may simulate an agent only as themselves.
rules.adminSimulatesByRole: The company admin may simulate an agent for a chosen person or for a role.
rules.onlyToolsOnAreConsidered: A simulation considers only the tools that are on for the agent.
rules.personRestrictionAppliesInRequest: When someone calls an agent, the tools that person may not use are not available to the agent in that request.
rules.noTechnicalIdsOnScreen: Screens show readable names only and never show technical ids.
rules.toolKeyUnique: Each action has one tool in the catalog, matched by its stable code when the catalog is rebuilt.
rules.toolNeverDeleted: A tool is never deleted from the catalog; one that leaves the release is marked removed.
rules.catalogRebuiltOnRelease: The tool catalog is rebuilt when a module is created or a new release arrives: new tools are created, tools that already exist are updated by matching their stable code, tools that left the release are marked removed, and tools that came back become available again. On every rebuild, each tool's stored catalog item is replaced with the whole item as the platform delivers it, so the stored catalog never goes stale.
rules.removedToolNotSent: A tool marked removed is not sent to the cm as a tool an agent may use.
rules.adminChoiceNeverOverridden: Once the admin has turned a tool on or off for an agent, no automatic step changes that choice.
rules.oneChoicePerAgentAndTool: There is at most one on or off choice for each pair of agent and tool.
rules.onlyEnabledToolsSent: When the cm asks for an agent's tools, only the tools that are on for that agent are sent, each with its whole stored catalog item.
rules.removedToolNeverSent: A tool choice that refers to a removed tool is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.
rules.personRestrictionsExcludeTools: When the cm asks for an agent and a person, the tools that person may not use are left out of the tools returned.
rules.repeatedNoticeChangesNothing: A notice from the cm that has already been handled changes nothing when it arrives again.
rules.draftSuggestedToolsTurnedOn: The tools suggested in a ready draft are turned on for it as automatic choices, without changing any choice the admin already made.
rules.restrictionUniquePerPersonTool: A person has at most one restriction for each tool.
rules.restrictionAppliesThroughAnyAgent: A tool restricted for a person cannot be used by that person through any agent.
rules.onlyCompanyAdminRestrictsTools: Only the company admin may mark or unmark the tools a person may not use.
rules.removedToolRestrictionKept: A restriction on a tool that was marked removed is kept and has no effect while the tool is gone.
rules.executionRecordedOnce: The same finished execution is never recorded twice, even when its summary arrives again.
rules.onlyInboundWritesExecution: Execution summaries are recorded only from what the cm sends.
rules.executionNeverEdited: A recorded execution summary is never changed afterwards.
rules.onlyActiveUsersRestricted: Only active organization users are offered for tool restrictions and for simulation.
rules.draftDecisionOnlyWhenReady: Only a ready draft can be decided on: activating it makes it activated and discarding it makes it discarded.
rules.refusalReasonShownWhenRefused: A refused draft is shown with the reason the cm gave for refusing it.
rules.activityNewestFirst: An agent's activity is listed newest first.
rules.newToolsChosenFromDescription: New tools in the catalog are chosen automatically from each agent's description for every agent of the company, read from the cm, not only for agents that already have a tool choice; the admin may then adjust them.
rules.describeAgentForPersonWritesNothing: When the cm asks this module to describe an agent for a person, the module only reads: it returns only the tools that are on for that agent, minus the tools that person may not use, each with its whole stored catalog item; it invents nothing and writes nothing.
rules.toolKeepsWholeCatalogItem: Each tool in the catalog keeps the whole catalog item as the platform delivers it, not a part of it.
rules.agentToolsShowWholeCatalog: The agent tools screen shows every action of the tool catalog, with the ones the agent has turned on shown as marked.
rules.markingWithoutChoiceCreatesAdminChoice: When the admin marks an action the agent has no choice for yet, a new choice for that agent and that action is created as an admin choice; marking or unmarking an action that already has a choice only turns that choice on or off.
rules.agentDraftRecordedBeforeSending: When the admin asks for a new agent, this module records the prompt, who asked and when, starts the draft as preparing, and then sends the request to the cm.
rules.refusedDraftKeepsReason: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that it refused a draft, the draft becomes refused and keeps the reason the cm gave; no one on the screen makes a draft ready or refused.
rules.conductChangeRecorded: Every time a member changes their conduct with an agent, this module records who changed it, when and a one-line summary; the current conduct itself stays in the cm.
rules.ownConductHistoryOnly: A member, and likewise the company admin, sees only their own conduct changes, newest first, never anyone else's.
rules.toolCatalogTextsStoredAsDelivered: The tool texts that come from the platform (the tool's stable code, module, subject, name, module title, subject title and release label) are stored exactly as they arrive: this module sets no size limit of its own, never cuts them and never refuses them for their size.

capabilities.agents.toolsForRequest: Answers the cm, for an agent and a person, the tools that are on and not removed, minus those the person may not use; used by the cm on each request with no screen open.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: The agent (or its draft) of the cm this tool choice belongs to; the row stores the cm id, which is never shown on screen.

toolId.title: Tool
toolId.description: The action of the tool catalog that is turned on or off for this agent.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Whether this tool is on for this agent; only tools that are on are sent to the cm.

choiceSource.title: Chosen by
choiceSource.description: Who made the current choice: the admin, or the automatic choice from the agent description. An admin's choice is never changed by the automatic choice.

details.title: Details
details.description: What else is kept about this tool choice.

decidedAt.title: Chosen on
decidedAt.description: When the tool was last turned on or off for this agent; filled by the system on each change.

decidedBy.title: Chosen by person
decidedBy.description: The company admin who made the choice; empty when the automatic choice made it.

values.title: New tool after a catalog update

automaticOrigin.title: Automatic origin
automaticOrigin.description: Which automatic step set the choice, when it was not the admin.

toolName.title: Tool
toolName.description: The readable name of the tool, read from the tool catalog, shown in the module / subject / action tree.

toolRemoved.title: Removed
toolRemoved.description: True when the tool this choice refers to has left the current release and is marked removed in the tool catalog; it is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.

Tool.title: Tool
Tool.description: One action of the tool catalog, from an app module or from the cm itself, placed in the module / subject / action tree with a readable name and description. Rebuilt when a module is created or a release arrives; a tool that leaves the release is marked removed and never deleted.

agentChoices.title: Agent choices for this tool
agentChoices.description: Each agent tool choice refers to one tool of the catalog.

restrictions.title: People restricted from this tool
restrictions.description: Each restriction blocks one tool of the catalog.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads one tool by its id to show its name and description in the agent tools tree, the restriction list and the activity of an agent.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists the tools filtered by module, subject and situation to build the module / subject / action tree for the company admin and the members.
capabilities.locate.byText: Finds tools whose name contains the typed text, for the search box of the tools tree and of the people restrictions screen.
capabilities.count: Counts the available tools per module or subject for the tree headers.
capabilities.create: Adds a new tool when the catalog is rebuilt after a module is created or a new release arrives, upserting by tool key so a repeated rebuild adds nothing twice.
capabilities.update: Refreshes the readable name, description and release of a tool during the catalog rebuild, and replaces its stored catalog item with the whole item the platform delivers now.
capabilities.transition: Marks a tool removed when it leaves the release, or available again when it returns, moved only by the catalog rebuild.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second tool with the same tool key, so each action of the release appears once in the catalog.
capabilities.transaction: Writes the whole catalog rebuild all or nothing, so the tree never shows half a release.
capabilities.agents.rebuildCatalog: Rebuilds the tool catalog from the actions of the app modules and the cm tools whenever a module is created or a new release arrives, with no screen open, replacing the stored catalog item of every tool with the whole item the platform delivers.
capabilities.agents.toolTree: Returns the whole catalog as a module / subject / action tree with readable names, for the agent tools scenario, the draft review and the people restrictions screen; on the agent tools scenario every action of the catalog is listed, with the agent's existing choice shown marked on the ones the agent has turned on.

toolKey.title: Tool key
toolKey.description: Stable code of the action in the release, used to match the tool when the catalog is rebuilt. Never shown on screen.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Whether the action comes from an app module or from the cm itself.

moduleName.title: Module
moduleName.description: Module the action belongs to: the first level of the module / subject / action tree.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject inside the module: the second level of the tree.

name.title: Name
name.description: Readable name of the action shown in the tools tree and the restriction lists.

status.title: Situation
status.description: Whether the tool is in the current release or has left it. A removed tool is kept, never deleted.

details.title: Details
details.description: Readable texts and release information of the tool.

moduleTitle.title: Module title
moduleTitle.description: Readable name of the module shown in the tree.

subjectTitle.title: Subject title
subjectTitle.description: Readable name of the subject shown in the tree.

description.title: Description
description.description: Plain-language explanation of what the action does, shown next to its checkbox and used to suggest tools from an agent description.

releaseLabel.title: Release
releaseLabel.description: Release in which the tool was last found when the catalog was rebuilt.

addedAt.title: Added on
addedAt.description: When the tool first entered the catalog.

removedAt.title: Removed on
removedAt.description: When the tool left the release and was marked removed.

usedByAgents.title: Agents using it
usedByAgents.description: Number of agents that have this tool turned on.

catalogItem.title: Catalog item
catalogItem.description: The whole catalog item of the action exactly as the platform delivers it, not a part of it. Every catalog rebuild replaces it, so the stored item is never stale. When the cm asks to describe an agent for a person, this whole stored item is returned for each tool that is on for that agent and that the person is not restricted from. Never shown on screen.

transitions.description: The catalog rebuild finds that the action left the release and marks the tool removed; it stays in the catalog and is no longer sent to the cm.
The catalog rebuild finds the action back in a new release and makes the tool available again.

grants.title: Manage agents, drafts and behavior
grants.description: The company admin sees every agent and draft of the organization, creates virtual employees, chooses the outcome of a ready draft and activates or discards it, configures agents, changes or undoes their behavior and simulates them by person or role; drafts are kept in this module, while agents, behavior and simulations come through the cm.

dataScope.description: All agents of the organization as the cm keeps them and all drafts of the organization kept in this module.

disclosure.description: The admin reads everything the cm returns about agents, behavior and simulations and the whole draft recorded in this module (prompt, requester, time, situation, suggested tools or refusal reason); screens still hide technical references.

grants.title: Manage the tool catalog, agent tools and people restrictions
grants.description: The company admin browses the tool tree, turns tools on or off for each agent and marks per person the tools that person may not use through any agent.

dataScope.description: The whole tool catalog, every agent's tool choices and every person's restrictions in the organization.

disclosure.description: Everything except the stable release code of the tool and the whole stored catalog item, which are technical and never shown.

grants.title: Choose organization users
grants.description: The company admin picks organization users from the platform user list to restrict their tools, simulate as them or name them responsible for an agent.

dataScope.description: All users of the organization.

disclosure.description: Name, whether the user is active and the login e-mail read from the platform login.

grants.title: Read agent activity
grants.description: The company admin reads the execution summaries the cm sent for every agent, newest first.

dataScope.description: Every execution of every agent of the organization.

disclosure.description: Everything about the execution except the cm's technical execution reference.

grants.title: My own conduct with an agent
grants.description: The company admin, like any member, reads and changes how an agent that has a personal conduct for them behaves for them.

dataScope.description: Only the conduct changes recorded in this module for the person signed in; never anyone else's.

disclosure.description: The whole conduct of the signed-in person, read from the cm, and their own conduct changes (who, when and a one-line summary), newest first.

grants.title: My current conduct with an agent
grants.description: The company admin, like any member, reads and changes how an agent that has a personal conduct for them behaves for them; the current conduct stays in the cm.

dataScope.description: Only the conduct the cm returns for the person signed in, for agents whose reading from the cm brings their personal conduct; never anyone else's.

disclosure.description: The whole conduct of the signed-in person, read from the cm.

grants.title: See the agents
grants.description: Every organization member sees the agent cards and the overview: name, what it is, its audience (the people of the company, a room or people from outside), whether it is on and who is responsible.

dataScope.description: All agents of the organization.

disclosure.description: Card and overview fields; the limits of the configuration scenario are for the admin.

grants.title: See what the agents did
grants.description: Every organization member reads the executions of the agents, newest first: when, how long, cost, actions and results, whether a person took over and the link to the conversation.

dataScope.description: Executions of all agents of the organization.

disclosure.description: Everything about the execution except the cm's technical execution reference.

grants.title: See who called an agent
grants.description: Members see the name of the person who called an agent in the activity and of the person responsible for it.

dataScope.description: Users of the organization shown in agent cards and activity.

disclosure.description: Only the person's name and login e-mail.

grants.title: Read the tool tree
grants.description: Members read the readable names and descriptions of the tools, so simulation results show the module, subject and action in plain words.

dataScope.description: The whole tool catalog.

disclosure.description: Readable names, description and whether the tool was removed; no technical code, release data or whole stored catalog item.

grants.title: Simulate an agent as myself
grants.description: A member checks which tools an agent can or cannot use for them and why, and how it reads a sentence they type.

dataScope.description: Only simulations run for the person signed in; a member never simulates another person or a role.

disclosure.description: The whole simulation result for themselves, without the role choice reserved to the admin.

grants.title: Change my conduct with an agent
grants.description: A member reads and changes how an agent that has a personal conduct for them behaves for them, and sees the history of their own changes.

dataScope.description: Only the conduct changes recorded in this module for the person signed in; never anyone else's.

disclosure.description: The whole conduct of the signed-in member, read from the cm, and their own conduct changes (who, when and a one-line summary), newest first.

grants.title: My current conduct with an agent
grants.description: A member reads and changes how an agent that has a personal conduct for them behaves for them; the current conduct stays in the cm.

dataScope.description: Only the conduct the cm returns for the person signed in, for agents whose reading from the cm brings their personal conduct; never anyone else's.

disclosure.description: The whole conduct of the signed-in member, read from the cm.

rules.agentNameUniqueAmongActive: An agent's @name cannot be one already used by another active agent; the cm refuses it and the screen tells the admin the name is taken.
rules.agentDraftSuggestedToolsOnWhenReady: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that a draft is ready, the draft kept in this module becomes ready, keeps the tools the cm suggested, and every suggested tool is turned on for that draft's agent in this module.
rules.agentDraftNoticeIdempotent: An agentDraftReady report from the cm, whether ready or refused, that arrives again changes nothing.
rules.adminChoiceNotOverriddenByAutomatic: A tool choice the company admin made for an agent is never changed by the automatic choice of tools.
rules.agentBehaviorChangedOnlyThroughCm: An agent's behavior is read, changed and undone only through the cm; this module never stores it.
rules.behaviorChangeByAdminOnly: Only the company admin may change or undo an agent's behavior.
rules.undoRestoresPreviousBehavior: Undoing a change from the behavior history brings back the behavior the agent had before that change, and the change is shown as undone.
rules.ownConductOnly: An organization member may change only their own conduct with an agent, never the conduct of another person.
rules.conductOnlyForAgentActingOnBehalf: A member may change their own conduct only with an agent that has a personal conduct for them, that is, an agent whose reading from the cm brings that member's personal conduct (today only the agent Nora).
rules.simulationSavesNothing: A simulation only shows results and saves nothing.
rules.memberSimulatesOnlyAsSelf: An organization member may simulate an agent only as themselves.
rules.adminSimulatesByRole: The company admin may simulate an agent for a chosen person or for a role.
rules.onlyToolsOnAreConsidered: A simulation considers only the tools that are on for the agent.
rules.personRestrictionAppliesInRequest: When someone calls an agent, the tools that person may not use are not available to the agent in that request.
rules.noTechnicalIdsOnScreen: Screens show readable names only and never show technical ids.
rules.toolKeyUnique: Each action has one tool in the catalog, matched by its stable code when the catalog is rebuilt.
rules.toolNeverDeleted: A tool is never deleted from the catalog; one that leaves the release is marked removed.
rules.catalogRebuiltOnRelease: The tool catalog is rebuilt when a module is created or a new release arrives: new tools are created, tools that already exist are updated by matching their stable code, tools that left the release are marked removed, and tools that came back become available again. On every rebuild, each tool's stored catalog item is replaced with the whole item as the platform delivers it, so the stored catalog never goes stale.
rules.removedToolNotSent: A tool marked removed is not sent to the cm as a tool an agent may use.
rules.adminChoiceNeverOverridden: Once the admin has turned a tool on or off for an agent, no automatic step changes that choice.
rules.oneChoicePerAgentAndTool: There is at most one on or off choice for each pair of agent and tool.
rules.onlyEnabledToolsSent: When the cm asks for an agent's tools, only the tools that are on for that agent are sent, each with its whole stored catalog item.
rules.removedToolNeverSent: A tool choice that refers to a removed tool is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.
rules.personRestrictionsExcludeTools: When the cm asks for an agent and a person, the tools that person may not use are left out of the tools returned.
rules.repeatedNoticeChangesNothing: A notice from the cm that has already been handled changes nothing when it arrives again.
rules.draftSuggestedToolsTurnedOn: The tools suggested in a ready draft are turned on for it as automatic choices, without changing any choice the admin already made.
rules.restrictionUniquePerPersonTool: A person has at most one restriction for each tool.
rules.restrictionAppliesThroughAnyAgent: A tool restricted for a person cannot be used by that person through any agent.
rules.onlyCompanyAdminRestrictsTools: Only the company admin may mark or unmark the tools a person may not use.
rules.removedToolRestrictionKept: A restriction on a tool that was marked removed is kept and has no effect while the tool is gone.
rules.executionRecordedOnce: The same finished execution is never recorded twice, even when its summary arrives again.
rules.onlyInboundWritesExecution: Execution summaries are recorded only from what the cm sends.
rules.executionNeverEdited: A recorded execution summary is never changed afterwards.
rules.onlyActiveUsersRestricted: Only active organization users are offered for tool restrictions and for simulation.
rules.draftDecisionOnlyWhenReady: Only a ready draft can be decided on: activating it makes it activated and discarding it makes it discarded.
rules.refusalReasonShownWhenRefused: A refused draft is shown with the reason the cm gave for refusing it.
rules.activityNewestFirst: An agent's activity is listed newest first.
rules.newToolsChosenFromDescription: New tools in the catalog are chosen automatically from each agent's description for every agent of the company, read from the cm, not only for agents that already have a tool choice; the admin may then adjust them.
rules.describeAgentForPersonWritesNothing: When the cm asks this module to describe an agent for a person, the module only reads: it returns only the tools that are on for that agent, minus the tools that person may not use, each with its whole stored catalog item; it invents nothing and writes nothing.
rules.toolKeepsWholeCatalogItem: Each tool in the catalog keeps the whole catalog item as the platform delivers it, not a part of it.
rules.agentToolsShowWholeCatalog: The agent tools screen shows every action of the tool catalog, with the ones the agent has turned on shown as marked.
rules.markingWithoutChoiceCreatesAdminChoice: When the admin marks an action the agent has no choice for yet, a new choice for that agent and that action is created as an admin choice; marking or unmarking an action that already has a choice only turns that choice on or off.
rules.agentDraftRecordedBeforeSending: When the admin asks for a new agent, this module records the prompt, who asked and when, starts the draft as preparing, and then sends the request to the cm.
rules.refusedDraftKeepsReason: When the cm reports through agentDraftReady that it refused a draft, the draft becomes refused and keeps the reason the cm gave; no one on the screen makes a draft ready or refused.
rules.conductChangeRecorded: Every time a member changes their conduct with an agent, this module records who changed it, when and a one-line summary; the current conduct itself stays in the cm.
rules.ownConductHistoryOnly: A member, and likewise the company admin, sees only their own conduct changes, newest first, never anyone else's.
rules.toolCatalogTextsStoredAsDelivered: The tool texts that come from the platform (the tool's stable code, module, subject, name, module title, subject title and release label) are stored exactly as they arrive: this module sets no size limit of its own, never cuts them and never refuses them for their size.
